{{Top|leg}}
'''Spore/B''' was a chemical compound derived from the [[Bothan stun spore]]. It could cause unconsciousness in a target, and was used in both the [[Spore/B canister]] and [[Spore/B stun grenade/Legends|Spore/B stun grenade]].
